namibia.overview: Namibia's hiking is defined by the immense Fish River Canyon, a demanding 53-mile, multi-day trek through one of the world's largest canyons. Day hikers can tackle the towering red sands of Sossusvlei, walking up the spine of the 550-foot Dune 45 for panoramic desert views. The canyon trek requires a permit and a doctor's certificate, and is strictly limited to the cooler months to avoid extreme heat.

months.6: This is a prime month for the multi-day Fish River Canyon trek, with cool daytime temperatures and cold nights making the demanding 53-mile route manageable. The Sossusvlei dunes offer excellent early morning walking.

napa.overview: Napa and Sonoma offer solid day hiking through oak woodlands, redwood groves, and chaparral-covered hills overlooking the vineyards. Trails in the local state parks climb steadily to ridgelines, rewarding walkers with sweeping views of the valleys and distant mountains. Spring brings vibrant green hills and wildflowers, while summer and early fall can be hot and dry.

months.5: The weather is warm and dry, making it a good month for longer climbs up to the valley ridges.

new-orleans.overview: Walking here means short, flat nature trails and urban parks. Barataria Preserve in Jean Lafitte National Historical Park has boardwalks and dirt paths through swamp and marsh. In the city, Couturie Forest in City Park offers a brief escape on unpaved paths under the canopy.

months.2: Cool, mild days are comfortable for the boardwalks, though some paths can be damp after rain.
months.3: Spring warmth arrives, and the swamp boardwalks and Couturie Forest trails are pleasant before the heat builds.
months.4: Warm, comfortable days suit a short walk on the swamp boardwalks, though humidity begins to rise.
months.7: Heat and humidity peak, and insects swarm over the swamp trails, making walking unpleasant.
months.8: Hot, airless days leave the unshaded marsh trails punishing, and even the shaded boardwalks are sticky.
months.9: Heat and humidity linger, and sudden downpours can drench the swamp trails.
months.11: Mild, pleasant weather returns to the local nature trails.
months.12: Cool, mild days make a comfortable short walk through Couturie Forest.

nicaragua.overview: Nicaragua offers rugged day hikes focused on its volcanic peaks and cloud forests. The signature route is the steep, muddy climb up Volcán Maderas on Ometepe Island, usually done with a local guide, which rewards walkers with a crater lake and sweeping views of Lake Nicaragua. Other trails explore the slopes of active volcanoes and tropical reserves, with the best conditions falling between December and April.

months.2: Trails on Ometepe and in the cloud forests are at their driest, making the steep, root-tangled ascent of Volcán Maderas much easier to navigate.
months.10: Deep mud and frequent heavy rain make steep ascents like Volcán Maderas a tough slog, with summit views rarely breaking through the thick cloud cover.
